legalConsent.eulaBody:
END USER LICENCE AGREEMENT

This is a legal agreement between you and Agent as a Service Pte. Ltd. for the use of tutor-sg.

1. Licence Grant: We grant you a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the app for personal, non-commercial educational purposes.

2. Data Privacy: All child data (photos, answers, voice recordings) is processed on-device and never sent to our servers without your explicit consent.

3. No Warranty: The app is provided 'as is' without warranty of any kind.

4. Limitation of Liability: We shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of this app.

5. Updates: We may update these terms from time to time.
legalConsent.privacyPolicySummary: We collect minimal data. Your child's homework data never leaves the device.
legalConsent.privacyPolicyBody:
PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: 2026-05-06

1. What we collect: Email address (parent only, for account creation), Anonymised usage statistics (opt-in only).

2. What we NEVER collect: Photos of homework, OCR text, child's typed or spoken answers, child's name or profile data, voice recordings.

3. On-Device Processing: All AI processing happens locally on your device using downloaded models.

4. Third Parties: We use Supabase for parent authentication and receipt validation. No child data is shared.

5. Data Retention: We retain parent email and anonymised stats only. Child data is never stored on our servers.

6. Contact: privacy@tutor-sg.app
